comment: T4 baseline (docs/TESTING.md). `nodes` counts every node, `retainedNodes` only those that ask for a GPU buffer (the Labels), so `buffersAlive` reads as 'labels that actually drew' and `buffersRefused` as the allocations sokol turned down. Counters gate hard; milliseconds only report, with a warn threshold, because this is a shared developer box — SCENE-SCALE.md:197 records its own numbers being taken at load average 14-17. Keys are nested rather than dotted so tests/bench/check.ms can read them through the JsonValue accessors.
